claims.claim: Nina Thi Thi Tran, 25, of Hamilton, was arrested at a demonstration near Lothian Avenue and Bloor Street West on Oct. 14, 2026, charged with obstruct peace officer and mischief under $5,000.
Police allege Tran sat on a curb barrier and refused officers' requests to leave the area while road work was underway.
Tran is scheduled to appear in court at 10 Armoury Street on January 8, 2027.
Protesters stalled bike lane removal work in the Bloor West and Islington area Tuesday night and the province says the work will be done.
A third Canadian Armed Forces member and four civilians were charged in a kidnapping probe, announced by Toronto police Wednesday.
Police allege the victim was confined in a car at gunpoint, handcuffed and assaulted as suspects tried to access cryptocurrency assets.
Jack Miley, 24, a Toronto reservist, was arrested Sept. 24 and faces seven charges including kidnapping for ransom with a firearm and forcible confinement.
Investigators recovered at least four firearms, 2,700 rounds of ammunition and quantities of cocaine, methamphetamine and other controlled substances.
Ontario ministers Holland, Harris and Fedeli called U.S. softwood lumber duties unjustified as the Commerce Department decreased the duty rate to 24.75 per cent.
Christopher Lawson, 43, of Toronto was charged with an offence motivated by hatred related to an assault with a weapon and breach of probation.
Police allege the suspect made anti-immigrant and anti-South Asian remarks before assaulting a man working in the Danforth and Logan area on Oct. 13.
Michael, 17, was last seen Oct. 14 at about 2:33 a.m. in the Sheppard Avenue East and Meadowvale Road area; police are concerned for his safety.
Bradford says he wants to build hundreds of kilometres of high quality cycling infrastructure; his campaign says Chow has no plan to improve bike lanes.
Geddy Lee endorsed Brad Bradford and Jim Cuddy endorsed Olivia Chow in the mayoral race.
